issues: Chart y-axis draws a large solid teal filled area at bottom even for a flat $100k line — visually noisy for a fresh account with a single snapshot. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py autonomous_loop uses `await asyncio.sleep(CYCLE_SECONDS)` BEFORE the first cycle — background task waits 15 minutes on startup before ever running. Consider running one immediate cycle (if market_open) on startup or sleeping after run.

alpaca.py LiveAlpaca._await_fill computes range with `wait_s // 3` — with default 15s that is only 5 iterations of 3s = 15s (fine), but a mleg limit at exact -credit tick is unlikely to fill outside RTH; consider a slightly more aggressive limit_price for closes and/or logging fill diagnostics.

agent.py run_cycle selects candidates via `random.shuffle` then slices [:min(3, max(1,slots) if slots else 1)] — the parenthesization means when slots=0 it still evaluates 1 candidate, which cannot open (correct behavior via `approved >= slots` early-break but wastes a Claude call). Consider skipping candidate loop when slots==0.

alpaca.py LiveAlpaca.load_chain uses `strike_price_gte=S*0.97/lte=S*1.03` for the probe — for cheap high-IV names (e.g. NVDA at $130) this is only ~$4 wide and may return zero contracts on some expiries; probe window could scale with iv/spacing.

server.py /api/account computes `day_pnl = equity - day_start_equity` after also calling _fetch_account (which resets day_start_equity=last_equity every request); this is correct while last_equity is stable but has a subtle race across day boundaries.
